payload.character: uuid — the PC or NPC dropped, a character of the instance's campaign
payload.count: integer — optional, 1 by default: the tokens dropped at once (« × n »), from 1 to 12; a PC is dropped once
payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance the character is dropped on, when the command names no target
payload.q: integer — the axial column of the hex it is dropped on
payload.r: integer — the axial row of the hex it is dropped on
